summary: Round goal: land the durable runnable+eval delta for Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B under vLLM. Localized why the 11:49 baseline still died at 'setsid: failed to execute vllm': patch 003 had been REVERTED by the prior session's wall-clock timeout (its bench never ran), so the baseline re-hit B3 unpatched -- 003 itself is sound and is re-applied as base. Authored patch 004 on the Magpie benchmark script (the point-of-use layer, so it works with OR without 003): (1) self-heals the child framework env (verify 'vllm' CLI AND the bare-python3 client's transformers/huggingface_hub imports, else prepend a discovered framework bin, idempotent when healthy), (2) ROCr/HIP logical re-pin before the first device consumer (same repair as 003 at a different layer, idempotent), (3) eval-stage failure-mode guard: a failed run_eval with lm_eval still unimportable (this host's lossy PyPI) is reported as a missing eval dependency instead of discarding the completed throughput run; a real eval failure stays fatal. Verified patch applies cleanly standalone, stacked on 003, and via git apply -p1 against the live framework root. Cleared (my cards, exact hostile baseline env): server boots + CUDA graphs + /health 200 + correct generation; installed lm-eval 0.4.13 (retry-hardened pip) and ran a real gsm8k lm-eval smoke (limit=5) against the live server producing exact_match scores -- so the next deeper failure, if any, is only the full eval budget. Next: coordinator benches gate-comparable throughput + full accuracy (floor 0.5; advisory smoke consistent with a capable model).
